subject.title: [Feature]: Support Slack Enterprise Grid org installs

question: Should OpenClaw accept an explicit opt-in Slack Enterprise Grid org-install mode in the bundled Slack plugin through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102372?
rationale: The request adds new Slack config surface and changes workspace authorization and delivery semantics, and the issue has a protected maintainer label plus a linked PR that still needs proof and security review.

options.title: Review linked PR as candidate
options.body: Treat the open PR as the implementation path and require live org-install proof plus security and API-contract review before merge.

options.title: Defer to per-workspace accounts
options.body: Keep the current one-account-per-workspace model until maintainers approve a broader OAuth or Enterprise Grid design.

options.title: Reject org-install support for now
options.body: Close the direction only if maintainers decide Enterprise Grid org installs are outside the bundled Slack plugin scope.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR as candidate
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the implementation path and require live org-install proof plus security and API-contract review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current issue/PR proposal and has the most concrete implementation context, though final acceptance still requires maintainer authority.
